source.title: arXiv 2404.05039: StaccaToe, a single-leg robot that mimics the human leg and toe

methodNote: Backlash measured at the knee actuator output on the assembled leg; torque constants on the authors' dynamometer.

rig.torqueSensor: authors' dynamometer (model not given in the text)

note: 0.15° backlash, inside the maker's 0.19°. The same paper found the measured torque constants of its AK actuators below the specified values.
